before.title: Recovery cases, fee derivation, landings and allocations
before.description: Recovery case, claim, eligibility and follow-up tables are inserted directly. approve_recovery_case_terms, post_recovery_fee_candidate, approve_synthetic_landing, reverse_synthetic_landing, write_recovery_payment_payer_mark and write_recovery_allocation are runtime-executable. The six M4-8-S allocation tables (receipt_line_allocation, recovery_allocation_command, recovery_allocation_line_source, recovery_allocation_review, recovery_case_allocation, recovery_case_allocation_reversal) are SELECT-only for the runtime login; that result is preserved and no outstanding direct INSERT is invented. M4-9-S read_success_fee_v3 authenticates current synthetic owner/job; write_success_fee_v3 delegates that check; 0405/0406 enables synthetic catch-only exact positive/zero posting after lock and current SV-6 review. MON-4A adds only read_payment_fees/write_payment_fee checked synthetic statements/approvals; private sources and two immutable tables have no runtime table grant. No posting or collection authority is added. SV-6 assess_recovery_attribution now records exact synthetic owner reviews through the existing Decision/resolution/authorization tables and immutable command receipt, with current source/conjunct checks and audit atomicity. No direct runtime grant, fee, posting or collection is added. M4-9-S 0405/0406 enables only synthetic source-backed catch fee reviews and exact approved positive/zero posting. Six private immutable tables; no runtime DML, Q2, Q3, provider or collection authority.

responsibilities.LP-6c: money routines compare p_actor and p_tenant with the binding; fee posting is not changed here
responsibilities.LP-6d: remaining recovery routines and follow-up engine bind actor and tenant
responsibilities.LP-8a: allocation, reversal and fee-journal paths enforce actor, resource, amount, state and exact approval
responsibilities.LP-8b: M4-8-S SELECT-only grants remain closed; allocation dependencies traced

gaps: The FEE-BOTH-1 amendment does not authorise fee posting; this inventory changes no fee rule.
M4-9-S Q2/Q3, production activation, PostgreSQL CI and exact-head RED review remain gates.
